comment: MODE_PARAM holds the OFF/MONO/POLY state and has no ParamWidget, so it cannot be clicked; the MODE button steps it. The sixteen gate states and the sixteen pending-flip flags are likewise parameters with no widget, saved with the patch but unreachable by a click. The FLIP jack's test is a boolean OR of a float, not a threshold, so any non-zero voltage counts as high; every other trigger in this plugin uses Rack's 1V default. TO MUTE and OUT carry whatever is patched in, so they are given no family.
